# Regease — Gaming Signup Form\n\nRecreation of ColorLib Regform 9 (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/colorlib-regform-9/).\n\n## Design tokens\n- Background: Full-page gaming image (picsum.photos)\n- Card: rgba(177, 135, 77, 0.75) — gold/brown translucent\n- Font: Poppins (Google Fonts)\n- Text: white throughout\n- Submit: white bg, gold text, rounded 25px, box shadow\n- Sign-in: white border 2px, rounded 25px\n- Inputs: transparent bg, bottom border only
